behavior: Uses unchanged accepted template checkResult and capText with the pinned parseRemote reference; no duplicated result allowlist.
Expected job and binding digest come from a detached validated snapshot of the trusted sent wrapper.
Malformed, absent, noncanonical, oversized or mismatched remote text becomes UNKNOWN REMOTE_NO_RESULT.
Local source pin/import failures are LOCAL_REFUSAL, not fabricated remote results.
Public output contains only the exact eight fields and state/code summaries; readiness remains NOT_ASSESSED.
limitations: Trusted actually-sent wrapper provenance, native capture completeness/authenticity and transport success remain caller responsibilities.
No CONFIG-nonnull payload, Linux/native process, database, browser or host execution.
Transparent proxies cannot be identified portably; reflection traps may run caller code. This is not an arbitrary-object sandbox.
Accepted remote UNKNOWN has no binding certificate; job binding is checked without claiming certificate identity.
No readiness, production identity, measured quota or operational GO follows from local acceptance.
